name: eCourtsIndia MCP
summary: Remote MCP and partner API over Indian court and tribunal cases, orders, judgments and cause lists, with OAuth and starter credits.
description: MCP endpoint https://mcp.ecourtsindia.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth on Connect; optional ?token=). Server v4.10 exposes 27 tools: enum/discovery, search_cases and cause-list search, case/order retrieval (including get_order_markdown and get_order_ai_analysis), monitoring and refresh. Public web pages (search, CNR, orders, advocates) need no key; partner REST and MCP require auth. Court-structure and enum lookups are free; case/order/search calls use credits, with free starter credits on signup. Setup page at /api/mcp; agent card at mcp.ecourtsindia.com/llms.txt.
